text: 。AbstractObjectiveTo outline the commonly used databases and evaluation methods for Herb-Drug Interactions (HDIs) and explore ways to evaluate Chinese Herbal-Drug Interactions (CHDIs).MethodsCNKI and PubMed were searched for related literature published from inception to March 19, 2024. The HDI database, causal inference, evidence grading and quality assessment, as well as methods for evaluation of clinical relevance were summarized.ResultsClinical decision support (CDS) systems required all-round assessment of the quality grading of evidence, clinical relevance, risk factors and adverse reactions
